description: This file defines the FixedDepositAccountBusinessEventSerializer class, which implements serialization logic for fixed deposit account business events in the Fineract project. It converts business events into Avro data transfer objects and specifies the supported schema.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: Serializer handling conversion of fixed deposit account business events into Avro DTOs, supporting schema retrieval.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the given business event is an instance of FixedDepositAccountBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a FixedDepositAccountBusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro data transfer object using the data mapper.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the Avro schema class supported by this serializer.
